title: Ticket pricing
prompt: ticket_price(age, is_student) implements the cinema's price list: under 12 pays 5, 65 and over pays 7, students pay 8, everyone else pays 12. Adults who are not students are being charged the student price.
hints: Trace ticket_price(30, False) line by line. Which return runs?
With 'or', the condition is True if either side is True. Is 30 < 65?
By the time that line runs, age is already known to be under 65. Only the student flag matters there.
explanation: The student rule used 'is_student or age < 65'. Every remaining age is under 65, so the condition was always True and adults paid the student price.
